decisions.statement: Every commit a landing writes carries the attribution.
The attribution is composed by the command rather than typed by the agent.
The attribution lines come last in the message.
A message already carrying a trailer key does not take a second line under that key.
A key already there is matched whatever case it is written in.
Each key is settled on its own, so a message carrying one of the two gains only the other.
A message whose last block is all trailers takes the attribution with no blank line.
A subject line holding a colon is prose rather than a trailer.
A model is named as a reader reads it, worked out from the id rather than listed.
A commit no model is recorded for is co-authored as Claude.
The model is read as the id a seat records rather than as a name for a reader.
A subagent records no model and is answered from the seat that ran it.
No session line is written where no session is known.
The session named is the one the environment names rather than the one the seat page states.
A seat page states the session the attribution names.

definition: the lines a commit message ends with naming the model and the session that wrote it
